scope.execution: static analysis only; tests were not run

violations.description: The file-backed demo-store test uses one repository-wide SQLite path and never removes the database. Separate test processes or later runs therefore share persistent records and lock state.
violations.suggestion: Create a unique scoped test directory/database per process or test case and remove it in RAII teardown. Do not change the independent in-memory SQLite tests.

isolation_evidence.environment_variables: Child-test variables are applied with Command.env only; the parent process environment is not mutated and needs no restoration.
isolation_evidence.credential_manager: Targets use a fixed test-only namespace plus process ID and atomic round. CredentialCleanup deletes on scope exit, the child also explicitly deletes, and the parent probes absence before and after.
isolation_evidence.playwright_fixture: Each Playwright test receives its own page/context. addInitScript rebuilds command behaviors, invoke calls, and external-call arrays per page; setResponse/setError mutate only that page. Shared default values are merged into a new behavior object and structured-cloned into the browser.
isolation_evidence.vitest: Testing Library cleanup runs after each test, restoreMocks is enabled, and Tauri invoke mocks reset before each transport test.
isolation_evidence.rust_globals: Atomic correlation and temporary-path sequences are thread-safe, and tests do not assert exact sequence values or depend on prior tests.
isolation_evidence.sqlite: Independent in-memory DemoStore instances are correctly isolated and are not violations; only the fixed file-backed database is shared.

recommendations: Use a scoped unique path and RAII cleanup for the file-backed SQLite contract test.
Keep child-only environment injection and the CredentialCleanup guard.
Retain per-test Playwright page state and structured-cloned command behavior maps.
summary: Isolation is strong except for one high-severity shared file-backed SQLite database without cleanup. Environment variables, Credential Manager targets, Vitest cleanup, and Playwright fixture state are isolated per process or test.
